description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

PathAI develops AI-powered pathology solutions to improve patient outcomes through machine learning and artificial intelligence. The Software Engineer I, Fullstack will build and enhance software across the stack, contribute to application platform architecture, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and support a reliable, compliant SaaS platform for clinical trial workflows.
Full-stack engineer building SaaS applications for clinical trial workflows, ensuring reliability, data integrity, and regulatory validation

Responsibilities:
• Solve interesting problems with code
• Build new features for internal and external users, and refactor existing ones to make them better
• Work with a wide range of systems, processes, and technologies to solve problems in sustainable ways. Sometimes you'll be neck-deep in low-level systems, and other times you'll be pairing up with the front-end team on the user interface
• Drive the architecture of our application platform, considering the team and our future product roadmap
• Collaborate with product, design, machine learning, and infrastructure teams
• Drive and uphold high engineering standards, bringing consistency to the codebases you encounter and ensuring software is adequately reviewed, tested, and integrated
• Mentor, learn, and share knowledge with others along the way
• Take responsibility for the quality of the code produced by you and the team
• Contribute to a SaaS platform used in clinical trial workflows, ensuring reliability, data integrity, and compliance with industry standards
• Collaborate with clinical, QA, and regulatory teams to ensure software changes meet validation expectations and support inspection readiness

Requirements:
• You have a Bachelor of Science or an advanced degree in Computer Science or equivalent
• You have some experience working across the full software development lifecycle using Python
• You are proactive and have demonstrated the ability to learn quickly in a complex space
• You have experience and skills in designing and building python-based (FastAPI or Django) applications
• You have a demonstrated foundation in data structures, algorithms, and OO design
• You have the ability to collaborate with a distributed team and to work autonomously on projects

Preferred:
• You have demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment
• You have Cloud Platform experience (AWS); knowledge of some IaC framework
• You have hands-on experience with CI/CD tools like GitLab CI
• You have knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and container orchestration tools like Kubernetes
